pairs.locus: Iacobus de Voragine, Historia de Sancto Vincentio
pairs.question: Ubi nunc tuum miserrimum corpus conspicis?
pairs.derivation: Dacianus questions Vincentius on the rack. Dropped the speech-framing imperative 'Dic mihi, Vincenti,' at the start (narration of the asking), keeping the contiguous interrogative 'ubi nunc tuum miserrimum corpus conspicis'; normalized capitalization and the terminal '!' to '?'. The answer is Vincentius's quoted reply 'At ille subridens ait: "Hoc est, quod semper optavi."' with the speech tag 'At ille subridens ait' dropped; it genuinely answers (he embraces the state of his body).
